notes.title: The Servant of the Lake Demo is coming to Steam Next Fest
notes.content: [h3]The Servant of the Lake Demo is coming to Steam Next Fest on Oct 13th! 🗓️[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45603363/adf0c16eacd5b4cfb4ecf43d9c4dbb4948f91de7.gif"][/img][/p][p]In just a few weeks, you'll be able to board the carriage and begin your 15-30 minute free trial. 🏡 After all... the Vanderbooms need to know if you are fit for the role of Servant of the Lake! 👀[/p][p][b]Wishlist the Servant of the Lake demo now! 👇[/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3996940/Servant_of_the_Lake_Demo/?curator_clanid=33593611"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: A carriage ride to Gamescom - Aftermovie
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=roWyNkkQe4s;full][/previewyoutube]

What a carriage ride! 🐎🛞 Thanks to everyone who visited us at the Indie Arena Booth, Gamescom! Fans, cosplayers, newcomers we are truly honored! 🎟️

We had an incredible time showcasing the very first demo of Servant of the Lake, dropping our announcement trailer at Future Game Show and letting you all hunt for some hidden 🦐

Massive shoutout to our amazing showcase team and to Mike Wijdenbosch, our legendary coachman! Huge thanks to Atelier Clement for the stunning art direction, turning big ideas into reality with the right attention to detail. And of course to the Voskamp hall family for bringing a 100-year old vintage carriage to the show! A special thanks to Indie Arena Booth for their support and creating the best space full of creativity and love for indie games, year after year! 💜

We are gathering all your feedback to improve the demo. Next stop, a public demo on Steam! So please stay tuned! 👀

🎬 Aftermovie by Juun & Klaas - Hoyng Images 
🎶 Music by Victor Butzelaar

👜 P.S. How many shrimp did you spot in the video? Let us know know on socials or [url=https://discord.gg/rustylake]Discord[/url]! We have 5 more tote bags to give away to some lucky 🦐 hunters!

notes.title: Servant of the Lake - Official Announcement Trailer
notes.content:
In case you missed our official reveal in the awesome [url=https://youtu.be/ZVRK-bSdkjo?t=2291]Future Game Show[/url] Gamescom edition:

[previewyoutube=3m7ulmQhNu0;full][/previewyoutube]

Board the carriage to get swept back into the world of Rusty Lake!

Wishlist Servant of the Lake now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3636770/Servant_of_the_Lake/

Step inside the carriage  and get swept back into the world of Rusty Lake, where you are expected to begin your new job as a servant at the mysterious Vanderboom estate. 
Solve puzzles, serve the family and uncover their dark alchemical secrets in  Servant of the Lake, a new upcoming single-player point-and-click adventure in the Rusty Lake series. 

The full premium experience is expected to launch in Spring 2026!

Trailer by: Bob Rafferty
Voice-over by: Mike Wijdenbosch
Music: Victor Butzelaar
Sound design by: Jorick and Gilliam, Driftwood Audio

notes.title: Servant of the Lake World Premiere @ FGS
notes.content: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45603363/e1ece71d82d43174b0aa8ac98bb99b628d6a887e.png"][/img][/p][p]We’re thrilled to share that [b]Servant of the Lake[/b] will be part of the upcoming Future Games Show 🔴 Live Stream this coming [b]Wednesday, 🗓️ August 20th![/b] 🙌[/p][previewyoutube="ZVRK-bSdkjo;full"][/previewyoutube][p align="start"]Tune in for an exclusive first look at our upcoming Rusty Lake title! 🤩 And remember to [b]Wishlist Servant of the Lake[/b] for more updates! 👇[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3636770/Servant_of_the_Lake/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Sneak Peek at Some Behind the Scenes Art! 🖼️
notes.content: [h3]We hope you'll enjoy this early look at some of the art from Servant of the Lake, straight from Johan Scherft's studio![/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45603363/c7522cc35e6e234acbe1aadc76dd890e8356f9b0.jpg"][/img][/p][p]A few weeks ago, we had the incredible opportunity to visit the studio of the talented Johan Scherft and see the work in progress on some very special art for our upcoming game, Servant of the Lake. [/p][p][/p][p]Needless to say, we were blown away by what we saw! It not only inspired us but also recharged our creative energy as we continue working on Servant of the Lake! Make sure to Wishlist on Servant of the Lake for more updates! 👇[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3636770/Servant_of_the_Lake/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Servant of the Lake is Going to Gamescom 2025!
notes.content:
[h3]🔥 We have some exciting news straight from the shores of Rusty Lake! 🚣 [/h3][p][/p][p]As you might have discovered from playing The Mr. Rabbit Magic Show, we’ve been hard at work on a brand new Rusty Lake title! 👀 [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45603363/8cc4f06be96b6c7da180563c96edba3c3ebaec5d.png"][/img]
[/p][p]And now we can finally share that we’ll be showcasing our upcoming premium Rusty Lake game, [b]Servant of the Lake at Gamescom 2025 as part of the Indie Arena Booth [/b][url="https://indiearenabooth.de/gamescom2025/games"]line-up[/url][b]![/b] 🎊[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3636770/Servant_of_the_Lake/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]This year’s booth is shaping up to be our biggest yet, so we hope to see you there. 🤩[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="ojc-RmYKGWg;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]In the meantime, please consider [b]wishlisting Servant of the Lake[/b] - it’s both a great way to help us out but also the best way to stay up to date with the development process! 🙏[/p]
